Sphinx and Furo publish their stylesheets, scripts, icons and extension helpers under _static, including a Python module and its bytecode that were never meant to be public; the Astro build bundles its own hashed assets and publishes none of these
the sphinx-design extension's stylesheet and script are Sphinx theme internals; the Astro build has no equivalent
the Sphinx incremental-build stamp is not a page and has no meaning for the Astro build
the Sphinx search index is replaced by the Pagefind index under /pagefind/
the old landing page stylesheet is bundled into the Astro landing page, which ships hashed assets under /_astro/
the old landing page script is bundled into the Astro landing page, which ships hashed assets under /_astro/
the shared header, shell and token files were loaded by the old landing page and the Sphinx theme; the Astro build imports them at build time and bundles them under /_astro/
